greeting: Quviasuutiqaqtugut ilissik qaninganiittugut, ataniq aanniaqtut inuusiup iluani, Ataata, Ilisimalluta qaninganiittugut. Atii taanna Aanniqtussat Ataniup iluani, Atataata, Irniup, Anersaap Illernap atianik. Amen.
penitential:
Ataniiq nalligisigut.
Kristii nalligisigut.
Ataniiq nalligisigut.
homily:
Ullaakkut, qiviartariaqarpugut inuusiup iluani, qanuq inuusiq asanniniqarpalaurmat. Qanuq takujariaqarpugut silami? Ullaakkut, qiviartariaqarpugut inuusiup iluani, qanuq inuusiq asanniniqarpalaurmat. Benjamin, taanna qaujimajavut tallimat pivalliajut, nuannaartuq, qajangnartuq, pinniqtuq. Taanna nalligivikluq, nalligikpatiklu qitiqquqsimajuq. Ilisimaliqput inuusiup iluani, qanuq Benjamin asanniniqarpalaurmat, qanuq ataniq asannininga kikkutuinnarnut tunijaupalaurmat. Taimanna atautikkut, qaujimajavut qanugitilluta.

Benjamin Vo, taanna qaujimajavut tallimat pivalliajut, nuannaartuq, qajangnartuq, pinniqtuq. Taanna nalligivikluq, nalligikpatiklu qitiqquqsimajuq. Ilisimaliqput inuusiup iluani, qanuq Benjamin asanniniqarpalaurmat, qanuq ataniq asannininga kikkutuinnarnut tunijaupalaurmat. Taimanna atautikkut, qaujimajavut qanugitilluta.

Qanuq inuusiq tusaajariaqarpugut? Qanuq inuusiq takujariaqarpugut silami? Jesus uqaqtuq, takujariaqarpugut silami, qanuq silaup inuusiup iluani. Benjamin, taanna 'con chim airlines'-mik uqalaurmat, quviasulluni. Taanna qajuqtuq inuusiup iluani, ataniup asannininga ilisimallugu. Ilisimaliqput taanna asanniniq, kikkut nalligijavut aniguqtilaaqtut.

Ryan, my dear brother, your brother Ben loved you. He was your partner. When you look at the sky, when you see a plane soaring high, remember that Ben's spirit is soaring too. He is free, he is full of light, and he is watching over you with a bright, gentle smile. Kikkut ilissik uqumaittumik atuqtut, kikkut uqalurialiqtut iluani, nalligivikluq ataniq qaninganiittuq. Ilisimajariaqarpugut ataniq qaninganiittuq. Ilissik ilisimajariaqarpugut asanniniq aniguqtilaaqtuq.

What can you carry out the door today? Take the peace of Christ. Take the memory of Benjamin's radiant smile. Know that you are deeply loved, held, and never alone. communion: Guutisiga Jesus, ilisimavunga qaninganiittutit iluani illernap sakramentip. Asannivunga illit piluarlugu, qinuvigivullu tikiullutit tarnima iluanut. Maannakkut tikiusimangninni, aquvugut ilillu atautikkut, saqqiqququvunga ilinnut, saqqiqququvunga asanniningani. Aŋalavigiuumiŋa, asanninirullu ilinnut. Amen.
standing_petitions: Benjamin piqatigalugu kikkullu aniguqtillugit, qaninganiittut ataniup qaujimajavut.
Kikkullu uqumaittumik atuqtut, ataniup tunisiguli asanniniq qanugitilluta.

readings.label: Siulleq
readings.text: Anersaat inuunermik ataniup ilianganiittut, aanniarutit aanniarqunagit. Silarjuup silarsuaani tuqunnikut isumajaugaluarlutik, piniqtuqtuutaugatik tuqutaugatiklu. Piunngulaungmata. Piniqtuup nalligisigai, asanniniqarpalaurmat.

readings.label: Tungiliirtuq
readings.text: Ataniq nalliginiqtuq, asanniniqarpalaurmat. Nunaqaqtitsiuq niqirjuup silarsuaani, imaqartitsiuq qaninganiittumik.

readings.label: Pingajuat
readings.text: Asanniniq ataniup tunijauvuq tarnitta iluanut anersaap illernap ikajuqtugut. Kristus tuquvuq angirumalluta, asanniniqarpalaurmat.

readings.label: Naalakkap Uqausia
readings.text: Jesus uqaqtuq: "Kikkutuinnait tunijaujut ataanamit tiguvagit, kikkut nalligijavut aniguqtilaaqtut."

day: The Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
